properties.name: spring.ai.mcp.client.authorization.aws.connections.*.region
properties.description: AWS region used in the SigV4 credential scope. Uses the default AWS region provider chain when omitted.

properties.name: spring.ai.mcp.client.authorization.aws.connections.*.allow-insecure-http
